newsitem.title: GERMANY: West German Q2 GDP rises 1.0 pct from Q1.
newsitem.headline: West German Q2 GDP rises 1.0 pct from Q1.

text.p: The Economics Ministry reported the following economic indicator:
W.GERMAN GDP Q2 96 Q1 96 Q4 95 Q3 95
NOTE - Quarter-on-quarter figures are adjusted for inflation (1991 prices) and for seasonal and calendar factors.
They are rounded to the nearest half pct point. The Federal Statistics Office earlier gave the bulk of the third quarter GDP figures. Previously announced data in brackets.
